second_fabrication_site.defect: Unconditionally wrote truth_check_history entry {verdict:'pass', failures:[], runner:'manual', source:'github_pr_merge_commit'} from nothing but 'PR is merged'. No truth-check ever ran in this function. runner:'manual' IS a canonical value, so a runner-union check alone could not catch it.

self_review_findings.summary: selectInferredMergedPr's title-or-branch OR made the title check vacuous since a conforming branch already embeds the issue ID; fixed to require a genuine title match.
The identical gap in reconcile.ts's resolveMergedPrForLane branch-inference fallback; fixed the same way.
The inferred-PR repair path had no origin/main reachability check, unlike the sibling explicit --pr path; added as defense in depth.

reconcile.ts's ghost_merged rule was eligible for reopened manifests, which signal a genuine detected regression; an unattended scheduled job could have silently overwritten that signal. Ghost eligibility now excludes reopened.
applyRepairPacket's GitHub-authority-drift check was dead code in the real CLI (fetchMergeAuthority never supplied); wired a real gh-backed implementation.
A failing repaired close persisted stale pre-run truth_check_history, discarding the just-measured failure entry. Extracted as manifestForFailedRepairClose and unit-tested.

ghost_lanes.mechanism: ops:reconcile ghost_merged rule (scheduled via .github/workflows/reconcile-stale-lanes.yml, every 6h on main)

detected.reason: Its own file_scope_lock includes docs/06_status/lanes/UTV2-1553.json, and file-scope-guard resolves base-branch manifests from the base copy, so a PR carrying the fix is evaluated against the ghost's stale lock-holding content. Applied and verified locally, then reverted; the scheduled reconciler applies it on main.

ghost_lanes.invariant: The reconciler transitions a ghost to merged only. done is a governance verdict that only a passing ops:truth-check may grant.

findings.summary: A lane manifest can be written with file_scope_lock: [], which validateManifest rejects, so readManifest throws and every ops tool that loads manifests through it refuses the lane outright. Observed live on UTV2-1590; it is why ops:lane-close --repair-merged could not repair either ghost.

Bootstrap deadlock: a ghost lane's stale file_scope_lock blocks the very PR that would reconcile it, because file-scope-guard resolves an existing manifest from the base branch copy. The automatic release therefore has to run on main (scheduled reconciler), not through a lane PR.

A second non-canonical truth_check_history runner population exists beyond the UTV2-1613 one: 55 entries under manual-reconciliation / post-merge-lane-close / manual-backfill / manual-close / operator / pm, plus 19 entries with no runner field. Not corrected here.
